name: Synthesise conflicting accounts
short_description: Synthesize 20 conflicting long-form accounts across three specialist contexts while preserving uncertainty and source positions.
self_assessment: I can synthesise 20 conflicting accounts across three specialist contexts without help and distinguish every unresolved disagreement.
description: Synthesize 20 conflicting long-form accounts across three specialist contexts while preserving uncertainty and source positions. The stated threshold defines a repeatable capability that can be demonstrated in a fresh but ordinary context. It covers preparation, execution, and checking the result within the named conditions. It excludes a one-off task or dependence on a particular product, institution, culture, or living arrangement, so the holder can assess and retain it as a transferable skill.
examples: Reconcile five accounts of the same event
